scenario: Trinket Mage finds nothing although Mana Crypt is there
cr: CR 701.23b (https://yawgatog.com/resources/magic-rules/#R70123b): "If a player is searching a hidden zone for cards with a stated quality, such as a card with a certain card type or color, that player isn't required to find some or all of those cards even if they're present in that zone."
reason: XMage's Trinket Mage searches with a target of exactly one card ("from 1 to 1") whenever one qualifies, so its controller cannot fail to find Mana Crypt.
